title: Mathematics Practice Test 1 - Mathematics - Similar Triangles
subject: Mathematics

questions.q: At a certain time of day, a flagpole casts a 9.0-foot-long shadow and a nearby 4.0-foot-tall fence post casts a 2.4-foot-long shadow. Given that both the flagpole and the fence post are vertical and on level ground, what is the height, in feet, of the flagpole?
questions.explain: Set up a proportion using similar triangles: $\frac{\text{height of flagpole}}{9.0} = \frac{4.0}{2.4}$. Therefore, $\text{height} = \frac{9.0 \times 4.0}{2.4} = \frac{36}{2.4} = 15.0$ feet.
